title: Continue gf2-core SOTA catch-up — close A8 + §6.3 follow-ups
description:
Continuation epic for the post-`97bf0879` SOTA catch-up work. Epic `97bf0879` ("Close gf2-core SOTA performance gaps") closed-done 2026-05-09 with all 76 FAIL cells routed via Annex A8 umbrella amendment to named follow-up JIT issues, and 11 cells classified EXCLUDED [§ 6.3] (gf2-side structural absences) under user-approved 2026-05-09 amendment. This epic organises those follow-ups into a single continuation effort with a coherent close contract.

## Background

`97bf0879`'s final scorecard (`dev/bench_results/2026-05-08-2cfc4372-sota-scorecard.md`) records the post-Wave-12 closure state:

- ~78 PASS cells (within 1.5× of best reference, or faster)
- ~11 AMENDED cells (user-approved aspirational, A1–A7)
- 76 FAIL cells (all routed to named follow-ups via Annex A8)
- 0 PENDING cells (post 2026-05-09 EXCLUDED §6.3 supersession of A9)
- 31 EXCLUDED cells (20 § 6.1+§ 6.2 no-oracle + 11 § 6.3 no-gf2-impl)

The 76 FAIL cells map to **5 currently-open follow-up issues** (per A8 routing breakdown):

- `615db3b9` (in_progress) — Pursue fflas-like GF(251) GEMM performance + broader finite-field dense LA SOTA catch-up plan; covers 57 cells (non-Mersenne GF(p) pluq/echelon/invert/solve, large-n fgemm, GF(2^31-1) echelon residuals, GF(31) dense-LA FAIL cells from Wave-12).
- `52cce970` (ready) — Bespoke small-prime AVX2 kernel for GF(251) charpoly+minpoly residual cells (covered originally by A1; also covers GF(31) charpoly n=256 added by Wave-12 measurement); 3 cells.
- `27bb2f75` (ready) — Optimize small-n GEMM dispatch path (n≤128) to close per-call-overhead gap; addresses A5 (GF(31)/n=64 fgemm) and A6 (GF(7)/n=64 fgemm) aspirational amendments; partial coverage of A7 (GF(251) fgemm small-n component).
- `aaa847cf` (ready, filed 2026-05-08) — M4RI-style invert path for `BitMatrix`; covers GF(2) invert at n=64,256,1024 (A8 rows 44–46) plus the 8 EXCLUDED §6.3 cells for GF(2) pluq + solve at n=64,256 × {uniform, deficient}.
- `5ce13bae` (ready, filed 2026-05-08) — Markowitz-degree pivot selection for sparse RREF; covers all 10 sparse-elim FAIL cells (sparse-elim × {GF(2), GF(7), GF(251), GF(65521), GF(2^31-1)} at n=256,1024).

`974a85bd` (closed-done) is referenced in A8's historical routing for 2 GF(2) matmul n<1024 residual cells (rows 4–5); the closure documentation of that story owns those cells. The remaining matmul × GF(2^4) EXCLUDED §6.3 cells (3 rows) require a sub-byte storage variant (`Gf2mWide<u4>`) and have no current named follow-up — a prerequisite scoping task may be needed under `615db3b9`'s broader plan.

## Scope

This epic is the work-tracking parent for the 5 follow-up issues above. Each follow-up has its own success criteria; this epic's contract is satisfied when each follow-up reaches `done` with PASS measurements recorded in an updated scorecard.

Out of scope:
- New SOTA target matrix surfaces beyond `97bf0879`'s definition (`dev/plans/sota_target_matrix.md`).
- gf2-coding decoder throughput (separate milestone).
- GPU offload research (separate epic).
- MSRV bumps (require separate user approval per `escalation-policy.md`).

## Success Criteria

- [hard] All five follow-up issues (`615db3b9`, `52cce970`, `27bb2f75`, `aaa847cf`, `5ce13bae`) reach state `done` with their respective scorecard cells PASSing the 1.5× threshold or carrying an explicit user-approved per-cell amendment recorded in the scorecard.
- [hard] An updated SOTA scorecard supersedes `dev/bench_results/2026-05-08-2cfc4372-sota-scorecard.md` and records the new measurements (raw walls + ratio-to-reference) for every cell newly closed by these follow-ups.
- [hard] No regression on cells currently PASSing in the `97bf0879` final scorecard (delta ≤ 5% under same-session measurement on the pinned reference host).
- [hard] No `unsafe` leaks outside `gf2-kernels-simd` / `gf2-kernels-hip`; high-level `gf2-core` and `gf2-coding` remain `#![deny(unsafe_code)]`.
- [hard] Bit-exact correctness preserved across all touched kernels (proptests for boundary lengths {0, 1, 15, 16, 17, 63, 64, 65}; field-axiom tests where applicable).
- [aspirational] The 11 EXCLUDED [§ 6.3] cells (matmul × GF(2^4) at n=64,256,1024; pluq × GF(2) at n=64,256 × {uniform, deficient}; solve × GF(2) same) gain implementations and re-enter scope as PASS — primarily owned by `aaa847cf` for the GF(2) cells; the 3 GF(2^4) cells require a `Gf2mWide<u4>` follow-up to be filed.

## Notes

- Parent milestone: `b117c95e` (gf2-core competitive performance long-running tracker).
- Predecessor epic: `97bf0879` (SOTA closure).
- Authoritative scorecard at epic close: `dev/bench_results/2026-05-08-2cfc4372-sota-scorecard.md` Annex A8 (routing) + § 6.3 (structural absences).
- This epic does NOT redefine the SOTA target matrix or open new measurement surfaces; it strictly closes the 76 FAIL routing entries (and aspirationally the 11 EXCLUDED §6.3 cells).
